app.name: Notion: Notes, Tasks, AI
app.description: An all-in-one workspace for notes, tasks, wikis, and databases with built-in AI features for writing, summarizing, and organizing content.

verdict.one_liner: Notion gives you decent control over your data and lets you opt out of targeted ads, but it tracks you across devices, shares identifiers with advertisers, and your information could be transferred in a corporate sale.
verdict.summary: Notion collects your account details, device information, and everything you create in workspaces. It uses cookies, advertising IDs, and cross-device tracking to market its own services through third-party advertising partners. Your data may also be shared with service providers, affiliates, and business partners, and transferred in mergers or acquisitions. On the positive side, Notion provides opt-out mechanisms for targeted advertising and data "sales," offers standard deletion and correction rights, and does not store your payment details directly. The policy is comprehensive but involves extensive data collection and third-party sharing.
verdict.recommendation_reason: Notion is a powerful productivity tool, but its privacy practices involve significant tracking and third-party data sharing. If you opt out of targeted advertising in settings and avoid storing highly sensitive personal information in your workspaces, it can be used more safely.

red.title: Tracks your activity across devices and websites
red.plain_english: Notion uses technology partners to track your browsing activity across different websites, devices, and apps to match your behavior on your phone with your behavior on your computer.

red.title: Collects advertising IDs and unique identifiers
red.plain_english: Notion collects mobile advertising identifiers, cookie IDs, MAC addresses, and other unique identifiers from your device to track and profile you.

red.title: Your data may be sold or transferred in a corporate deal
red.plain_english: If Notion is involved in a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, your personal information may be sold or transferred as part of that transaction.

red.title: Shares your data with advertising partners
red.plain_english: Notion shares identifiers, internet activity, geolocation data, and profile inferences with advertising partners to market its own services to you.

red.title: Continuing to use the app means accepting policy changes
red.plain_english: If Notion updates its privacy policy, you are automatically considered to have accepted the new policy just by continuing to use the app.

green.title: You can opt out of targeted advertising and data sales
green.plain_english: Notion provides a "Do Not Sell or Share My Info" link on its website and honors browser-based opt-out signals like Global Privacy Control.

green.title: Payment details handled by third-party processors
green.plain_english: Notion does not store your payment card details directly. Payments are processed and stored by third-party payment providers on Notion's behalf.

green.title: You can access, correct, and delete your data
green.plain_english: You have the right to request access to your information, ask for corrections, request deletion, and restrict how your data is processed.

green.title: Google Contacts data used only for email invitations
green.plain_english: If you use the Google Contacts feature, Notion only uses that data to auto-complete email addresses when sending invitations and promises not to use it for anything else.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention whether Notion accesses your camera or microphone.
categories.detail: Notion is a notes and workspace app. The privacy policy is silent on camera or microphone access. Users can upload images, but the method (camera vs file picker) is not addressed.
concerns: Policy is silent on camera and microphone access

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Notion automatically figures out your general location from your IP address, and with your permission may collect precise location information from your device.
categories.detail: The policy states that automatic data collection includes 'location information (including inferred general location based off of your IP address).' It also notes that 'with your consent, we may also collect precise location information if you use our Apps.'
categories.policy_excerpt: location information (including inferred general location based off of your IP address)... With your consent, we may also collect precise location information if you use our Apps.
concerns: Precise location may be collected with consent

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: If you use the Google Contacts feature, Notion can view your contacts to auto-complete email addresses when sending invitations, but says it will not use this data for anything else.
categories.detail: The Google Contacts integration is optional. Notion accesses contacts via the Google People API solely for auto-completing invitation emails. The policy explicitly states this data is not used for other purposes.
categories.policy_excerpt: Should you choose to use the Google Contacts feature within our Services, we will have the ability to view your contacts via the Google People API. The sole use of this data is to populate the auto-completion of your contacts when sending invitation emails.
concerns: Contacts are viewable by Notion via API when feature is enabled

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: Notion accesses your files when you actively choose to upload them into your workspace.
categories.detail: Notion is a workspace app where users upload documents, images, and other files as content. File access is user-initiated for the core functionality of the app. There is no indication of background file scanning.
categories.policy_excerpt: Content submitted, posted or modified by users in the Service is organized into separated sections that are referred to as 'Workspaces.'
concerns: Uploaded content is stored on Notion's servers

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Notion shares your data with service providers, advertising partners, affiliates, and business partners. It may also transfer your data in mergers or acquisitions. You can opt out of some advertising-related sharing.
categories.detail: The policy discloses sharing with service providers (for IT, marketing, payment processing, customer service), advertising partners (for targeted marketing of Notion's own services), affiliates, and business partners. Under CCPA disclosures, identifiers, internet activity, geolocation data, and inferences are 'sold/shared' to advertising partners. Opt-out is available.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may disclose information we collect about you to our third-party service providers... we may disclose your information to third-party advertising partners to market our own Services... If we are involved in a merger, acquisition... your information may be sold or transferred
concerns: Data shared with advertising partners for targeted marketing
Data may be transferred in corporate transactions
Cross-device tracking involves sharing data with technology partners

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: You need to give Notion your name, email address, and password to create an account. An optional profile photo and role information may also be collected.
categories.detail: Account creation requires name, email address, password, and role within team or enterprise. An optional profile photo may be uploaded. For organizational accounts, workspace content and profile info may be shared with the organization.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you create an account or otherwise use the Services, we collect information such as your name, email address, password, role within your team or enterprise, and an optional profile photo.
concerns: Organization-associated accounts may have data shared with the organization

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Notion uses cookies, pixel tags, and third-party advertising technology to track your online activity and show you targeted ads about Notion's own products across the internet.
categories.detail: The policy describes use of cookies, pixel tags, local storage, and third-party advertising technology partners to collect data for targeted marketing of Notion's own services. Cross-device tracking is explicitly mentioned. Users can opt out via website settings, browser controls, or the 'Do Not Sell or Share My Info' link.
categories.policy_excerpt: we may allow select third party advertising technology partners to place Technologies on the browser of your device to collect information about you... Your browsing activity may be tracked across different websites and different devices or apps.
concerns: Third-party advertising partners track users across sites and devices
Cross-device tracking matches mobile and desktop activity

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Notion says its services are not directed at children and it will try to delete data if it finds out it collected information from a child without proper parental consent.
categories.detail: The policy states services are intended for general audiences and not directed at children. If Notion becomes aware of collection from children without legally valid parental consent, it will take reasonable steps to delete the data.
categories.policy_excerpt: Our Services are intended for general audiences and are not directed at children. If we become aware that we have collected data without legally valid parental consent from children under an age where such consent is required, we will take reasonable steps to delete it as soon as possible.
concerns: No robust age verification mechanism described

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Notion logs your IP address, the pages you visit, links you click, and how you interact with the app.
categories.detail: Automatic data collection includes IP address, user settings, cookie identifiers, pages visited before/during/after use, links clicked, frequency and duration of activities, and other usage information. This is associated with accounts and other devices.
categories.policy_excerpt: We keep track of certain information about you when you visit and interact with our Website or Services. This information may include your Internet protocol (IP) address, user settings... pages that you visit before, during and after using the Website or Services, information about the links you click, information about how you interact with the Website or Services
concerns: Data associated across accounts and devices

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Notion collects your device type, operating system, browser details, MAC address, mobile advertising identifiers, cookie IDs, and uses cross-device tracking to build a profile of your activity across devices.
categories.detail: The policy collects extensive device and identifier information including IP address, MAC address, cookie identifiers, mobile carrier, mobile advertising identifiers, browser and OS details, and unique identifiers. Cross-device tracking explicitly matches browsing activity across devices using shared data from technology partners.
categories.policy_excerpt: This information may include your Internet protocol (IP) address, user settings, MAC address, cookie identifiers, mobile carrier, mobile advertising and other unique identifiers, details about your browser, operating system or device... we may attempt to match your browsing activity on your mobile device with your browsing activity on your laptop.

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: Notion does not collect health or biometric data.
categories.detail: The privacy policy does not mention any collection of health or biometric data.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Notion uses third-party payment providers to process subscriptions and does not store your payment card details directly.
categories.detail: Payment information is collected when purchasing subscriptions but is processed and stored by third-party payment providers on Notion's behalf. Notion may receive billing address and transaction information but does not directly store payment information.
categories.policy_excerpt: We use third-party payment providers to process payments on the Services. We may receive information associated with your payment information, such as billing address and transaction information, but we do not directly store payment information on the Services.

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can request access to your data, ask for corrections, request deletion, and restrict processing. However, Notion may keep some data for legal and business reasons even after you delete your account.
categories.detail: The policy outlines rights to access, correction, deletion, restriction, and objection. Requests must be verified via the account. However, data is retained 'for as long as you use our Services or as necessary to fulfill the purpose(s) for which it was collected, provide our Services, resolve disputes, establish legal defenses, conduct audits, pursue legitimate business purposes, enforce our agreements, and comply with applicable laws.'
categories.policy_excerpt: Request Deletion of your information, subject to certain exceptions prescribed by law... We store the information we receive as described in this Privacy Policy for as long as you use our Services or as necessary to fulfill the purpose(s) for which it was collected...
concerns: Data may be retained for legal and business purposes after deletion request

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Notion will notify you of material changes to the privacy policy as required by law, but if you keep using the app after changes take effect, you are considered to have accepted them.
categories.detail: The policy states that material changes will be notified 'as required by applicable law' and continued use after the new policy takes effect constitutes acceptance. The last update was September 29, 2025.
categories.policy_excerpt: If there are any material changes to this Privacy Policy, we will notify you as required by applicable law. You understand and agree that you will be deemed to have accepted the updated Privacy Policy if you continue to use the Services after the new Privacy Policy takes effect.
concerns: Continued use implies acceptance of updates
